author: Jason Stys
summary: Report expected-peer successful-read address coverage with separate function codes, interval unions, absent assets and capture gaps.
rationale: Makes passive monitoring coverage auditable without contacting devices or treating unobserved activity as safe.
limitations: Passive capture review only; no new wire-function support, active polling or device access is supplied.
Generic existing baselines are shown independently per address space; no polling expectation is invented.
Unobserved addresses are capture gaps, not failed devices, security passes or safety proof. IP labels do not establish device identity.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
